author: KEXP
description: Welsh guitarist Gwenifer Raymond finds inspiration for her latest release 'Last Night I Heard The Dog Star Bark' in the works of sci-fi ad scientific readings. In-studio with host Hans Fluegel, she shares a performance of "Jack Parsons Blues" and more.
title: Gwenifer Raymond performs "Jack Parsons Blues" & more Live on KEXP
